method: Read-only source comparison and independent recursive fixture-node calculation. No compiler regeneration, native invocation, SMT proof, existing receipt rewrite or source modification was performed.

generator_delta.change: The only generator diff is account_nodes(w, 1) immediately after recognizing the optional alloc effect.
rationale: Canonical structure traversal counts each dictionary/list and its values/elements; dictionary keys do not add nodes.

The pre-existing per-function charge 11 + 3 * parameter_count includes the function dictionary, name, parameter list and 3 nodes per parameter, one return list and return type, effects list and its 3 fixed strings, entry value and blocks list.

Recognizing the fourth effect string alloc adds exactly one canonical value node and no container. An unused declared alloc effect is permitted because the Core verifier requires required effects to be a subset of declared effects.
Every parser pass and each phase-zero loan-graph replay clears the header and initializes w[248] to 4. The added charge is per function occurrence in that pass and is not accumulated across passes.
account_nodes uses the existing MAX_CORE_NODES threshold and sticky error 58. The main parser rejects a nonzero error before output pass two; no profile limit or failure status was relaxed.

fixture_control_reasoning: The ordinary exact-limit fixture and allocating over-limit fixture differ only by inserting alloc in f0.effects, so their independent counts differ by one.

The allocating exact-limit control preserves the same output SSA and u8 type for function 1 / block 0 / op 507; it replaces a pure unused two-argument wrapping add with a zero constant having no arguments and one attribute value. Removing two operand-string nodes and adding one value node decreases the total by exactly one.

All four fixtures retain 17 functions, 797 blocks, 7512 instructions and max SSA 1358. Source sizes are 910057 or 910063 bytes, so the fixtures remain below independent function/block/instruction/SSA/source-size ceilings.

The existing native qualification now checks both allocating and nonallocating exact/+1 cases, requiring NO_SPACE with header error 0 at the exact limit, INVALID with header error 58 at +1, exact node counts, and unchanged source/output.

retained_failure_evidence.observation: The retained earlier native receipts returned NO_SPACE with header nodes 262144/error 0 on the independently counted 262145-node input; canonical admission rejected E_HIA_LIMIT.
retained_failure_evidence.identity_scope: These are the retained earlier v13 B3/M3 images, not the later parameter-fix image hashes. The same missing alloc charge is independently present in the compared latest pre-fix generator source. This review does not relabel earlier receipts as executions of a newer artifact.

limits: This is a scoped independent static review and fixture derivation; post-fix native/bootstrap/cold/language qualification remains the implementation owner's separate evidence.
No claim of full Core coverage, arbitrary compiler correctness, machine-level general proof, release qualification or production installation follows from this review.
